rules.text: NEVER fabricate papers, repos, or URLs. Only report what sensors actually found.
NEVER export OSINT data outside Mata Garuda.
ALL harvested URLs must be fed to NLM notebook NB-INTEL-AIResearch.
Complete Markdown report includes EVERY item, not a selection.
TG digest is a summary, not the full report. Reference the report file.
CLI-only: no API HTTP calls to Anthropic/Google/OpenAI.
Dedup by content hash before storing in KB.
If a sensor fails, continue with others. Never halt the full pulse.
